meta.name: seo-sxo
meta.description: Search Experience Optimization: reads Google SERPs backwards to detect page-type mismatches, derives user stories from search intent signals, and scores pages from multiple persona perspectives. Identifies why well-optimized pages fail to rank by analyzing what Google rewards for each keyword. Use when user says "SXO", "search experience", "page type mismatch", "SERP analysis", "user story", "persona scoring", "why isn't my page ranking", "intent mismatch", or "wireframe".

copy.tagline: 分析搜索意图，诊断页面排名问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果页面排名不理想，想从搜索意图角度找到原因。
